title: Travis Walton is struck by a craft's energy discharge

tellings.quote: >> they didn't choose Travis Walton. He ran up to the craft and got blasted.

plain: In Arizona in 1975, a man named Travis Walton ran up to a strange craft and was struck by a blast of energy from it. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan retells this from Walton's own account, and his point is that Walton was never chosen: "He ran up to the craft and got blasted." If that is right, what happened to Walton was an accident he walked into, not a planned taking.
